races.name: Gieves And Hawkes Supports The YCC Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: According To Mark
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who showed clear promise when second at Redcar over this trip, though 43 days off could affect peak fitness for Edward Bethell
runners_data.spotlight: Eye-catcher in sole 2yo start; went very close at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) on reappearance and the winner boosted that form by seeming to run well in the Chester Vase since; strong contender.

runners_data.name: Alma Latina
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent type with solid 1m2f form for Ralph Beckett, whose strong strike rate and the filly's breeding suggest maiden breakthrough is imminent
runners_data.comment: Showed plenty of promise when third at Sandown on debut; stable won this in 2022 and 2024
runners_data.spotlight: Out of a 1m2f Listed winner for her connections; has duly shown clear promise in two fillies' novice events over this trip, close second at Salisbury (good) latest; still open to progress and warrants respect.

runners_data.name: Maid On The Shelf
runners_data.note: Prominent racer bringing poor AW form and representing weaker stable, though 71 days since last run allows for significant improvement under the radar
runners_data.spotlight: Brings easily the worst form, having been comfortably held in 8.5f AW contest at Wolverhampton ten weeks ago; best watched unless the market suggests she's likely to take a big step forward.

runners_data.name: Fozzie
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader whose recent gelding operation sparked improvement, but pedigree questions at this extended trip despite two recent placed efforts
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown improvement with a couple of second-place finishes this term since being gelded, latest at Redcar (1m, good); one of the form contenders but pedigree raises a stamina doubt upped further in trip.

races.paceDynamic: Fozzie will lead from the gate with no other confirmed pace-setters in this small field, creating an uncontested advantage through sensible fractions. According to Mark, Alma Latina, and Maid On The Shelf will all settle prominently behind, but none are aggressive pace forcers. With just four runners and one clear leader, this sets up as a steady gallop that will likely quicken late when the prominent trio challenge. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can track the pace, as there's no early speed pressure to compromise their positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Fozzie Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Fozzie dictates comfortable fractions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run and maintains his advantage through the final furlong, while the prominent trio struggle to make up ground on the flat Pontefract finish. His recent gelding operation and improved form at this trip make him dangerous when allowed to dominate.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Prominent Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens from the two-furlong pole as the field closes on Fozzie
scenarios.body: According To Mark or Alma Latina produce superior finishing kicks to collar the leader in the final hundred yards. Both have shown better form levels than Fozzie and benefit from tracking his honest pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Alma Latina Class Edge
scenarios.trigger: If Ralph Beckett's filly shows the improvement her breeding suggests she's capable of
scenarios.body: The daughter of a Listed winner demonstrates superior ability late in the piece, using her proven 1m2f form to best advantage. Her consistent placed efforts suggest she's ready to break her maiden.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Fozzie sets overly generous fractions that compromise his finish
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader ties up badly in the final quarter-mile, allowing even the moderate Maid On The Shelf to get involved. This scenario requires a pace misjudgment from Shane Gray.

watchPoints.text: Fozzie's early pace judgment will determine the entire race complexion in this small field
According To Mark's fitness after 43-day break could compromise his finishing effort despite strong recent Redcar form
Alma Latina's market position will reveal Ralph Beckett's confidence in her maiden breakthrough
Maid On The Shelf's 71-day absence means any market support would signal hidden improvement for Charlie Johnston
Shane Gray's tactical ride on Fozzie critical as uncontested leader faces stronger-rated opponents

races.name: HBC Construction Ltd Supports The YCC EBF Maiden Stakes (For Horses Which Have Never Run) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Avionics
runners_data.spotlight: 45,000euros yearling, 150,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; Kodi Bear half-brother to German winners Willy Campbell (7f-1m1f) and Jane Garfield (6f), out of a maiden (RPR 69); the biggest eye-catcher in terms of sales info; respected.

runners_data.name: Boleto
runners_data.spotlight: 90,000euros foal, £105,000 yearling; by Wootton Bassett out of maiden (RPR 64) half-sister to Group 1 winners Broome (1m4f) and Diego Velazquez (1m) and daughter of of 5f 2yo Listed scorer; looks one of the likelier types.

runners_data.name: Desert Phantom
runners_data.spotlight: 42,000gns foal, 45,000gns yearling, 55,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; by Blue Point out of 7f AW 2yo winner (RPR 71); less interesting than some of the others in this field.

runners_data.name: Inns And Out
runners_data.spotlight: 1,500euros foal, 6,000euros yearling; by Inns Of Court out of maiden (RPR 45) half-sister to German 1,000 Guineas winner Electrelane; the least appealing contender.

runners_data.name: Raslan
runners_data.spotlight: Attractively bred colt, by New Bay and first foal of a 5f/6f winner (including debut and 2yo Group 3; RPR 110) for his connections; interesting contender, especially if the market speaks positively.

runners_data.name: Shemiyla Star
runners_data.spotlight: 62,000gns yearling; by Blue Point; sibling to seven winners, notably Sheraz (1m3f-1m7f including Listed; 116) and Lakota Sioux (7f 2yo including Group 3; 100); dam 1m2f scorer (including Group 3; 109); nicely bred.

runners_data.name: Kochella
runners_data.spotlight: 48,000euros foal, 71,000euros yearling, 72,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; Kodiac half-sister to 6f/7f winner Nights Over Egypt (including AW; RPR 79); dam unplaced 7f/1m AW 2yo (56); others have stronger-looking claims.

runners_data.name: Rosberg
runners_data.comment: This Palace Pier colt is in good hands and very much one to consider on his first run
runners_data.spotlight: 45,000gns foal, 125,000gns yearling; Palace Pier half-brother to Qatari 12.5f winner Beat The Clock, out of 1m winner (RPR 74); showed some promise with fourth-place finish at Thirsk (7f) on Sunday.

races.name: GV Co Property Consultants Supports The YCC Handicap

runners_data.name: Aberama Gold
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with excellent Pontefract record, trainer David O'Meara in moderate form but horse won three starts ago off this mark
runners_data.comment: Had a rare off-day at Thirsk a fortnight ago but is quite capable of bouncing back
runners_data.spotlight: Multiple winner down the years and gained his most recent success (narrowly, three starts ago) off current mark; subsequent dip in form is the negative.

runners_data.name: Bravo Zulu
runners_data.note: Prominent runner dropping back to optimum 6f trip, strong recent second at Redcar suggests current form is sharp
runners_data.comment: Prolific when first joining this yard but less to recommend him since December; trip query
runners_data.spotlight: Multiple 7f-8.5f winner who fared better than seemed likely when dropped to 6f at Redcar (good to firm; half-length second) last week; fighting chance off same mark.

runners_data.name: The Good Biscuit
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with exceptional Pontefract record including two wins this year, poor last run can be forgiven
runners_data.comment: Resumed in good form off his revised mark; adaptable and can't be discounted
runners_data.spotlight: Below par last time but consistent otherwise of late and may well rebound, especially back at Pontefract; form here features two wins in 2025 and a close second this spring.

runners_data.name: Emperor Caradoc
runners_data.note: Likely pace-setter on career-high mark but consistent Pontefract performer, will ensure honest gallop from the front
runners_data.comment: Suited by good to firm; successful at Thirsk last week; back on career-high mark
runners_data.spotlight: Still on career-high mark but latest effort (when bidding for 6f double) suggests he remains in form, and his Pontefract record is largely consistent; solid contender.

runners_data.name: Rock Opera
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in decent form with two recent placed efforts, still 7lb below last winning mark and drawn well
runners_data.spotlight: In reasonably good form having made the frame in last two starts, rallying both times; on a two-year losing spell but remain 7lb below last winning mark; enters calculations.

runners_data.name: Mr Cool
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning to preferred 6f distance after 7f campaign, both career wins came at this trip
runners_data.comment: Inconsistent and soundly beaten last time but runner-up previously and not discounted
runners_data.spotlight: Campaigned over 7f of late, generally leaving the impression he needs a return to 6f; has gained both wins at this distance and he's very attractively treated off current mark; respected.

runners_data.name: Alpha Capture
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making 6f return after longer trips, useful early career form at this distance but 45 days off
runners_data.spotlight: Form for new yard this term comprises two placed efforts over 1m and a running-on sixth over 7f; useful over 6f early in career but isn't crying out for the return to this trip.

runners_data.name: Maris Angel
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 158-day absence, 12lb higher than last turf attempt but strong AW form this winter
runners_data.spotlight: Absent since a respectable effort on Boxing Day when bidding for a Wolverhampton AW five-timer; only 1-9 on turf and is 12lb higher than last attempt in this sphere.

runners_data.name: Irish Nectar
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor turf record for current connections, best form came on softer ground than today's
runners_data.comment: Only beaten a head over C&D in February but below that level twice since.
runners_data.spotlight: Record of 0-6, mostly on AW, for current yard; ran encouragingly last time but chance back on turf may depend on the weather's actions; has done his winning on soft ground.

runners_data.name: Dashing Dick
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in poor early season form, hasn't won away from Newmarket since 2022 and others preferred
runners_data.comment: Won over C&D on final outing last term and it's very likely he needed his reappearance run
runners_data.spotlight: Ended last season with a success but has contrastingly started this campaign in poor form; hasn't won away from Newmarket since 2022; others preferred.

races.paceDynamic: Emperor Caradoc will lead from the gates with Bravo Zulu, Mr Cool and Dashing Dick tracking in prominent positions, creating a measured early gallop over this stiff 6f at Pontefract. The absence of multiple keen front-runners means the pace will be controlled rather than frenetic, allowing the large hold-up contingent including Aberama Gold, The Good Biscuit, Rock Opera, Alpha Capture, Maris Angel and Irish Nectar to get into contention. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce their finishing kicks from the back, as the controlled pace will leave plenty in reserve for the final furlong charge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Emperor Caradoc sets a steady tempo without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The measured pace allows closers to unleash devastating finishing kicks, overwhelming the front-runners in the final 100 yards. Multiple hold-up horses swamp the leaders simultaneously.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent horse prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with multiple prominent runners pushing
scenarios.body: Emperor Caradoc or Bravo Zulu maintain their positions while the hold-up brigade struggles to make up the ground. The sustained gallop plays to horses already in touch.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical muddle benefits outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling with no horse willing to commit early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where any horse can win regardless of early position. Outsiders with tactical speed can exploit the chaos.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-runner steals it
scenarios.trigger: If Emperor Caradoc gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while rivals wait too long to challenge. Hold-up horses left with too much ground to make up.

watchPoints.text: Emperor Caradoc must be watched closely early - if he gets an uncontested lead the race dynamic changes completely
Maris Angel's lengthy absence makes fitness a major question mark despite excellent recent AW form
Mr Cool's tactical positioning will be crucial as he needs to be closer than usual given the likely strong pace
The Good Biscuit's last run was poor and any repeat would end chances despite excellent course record
Bravo Zulu's ability to handle the drop back to 6f after recent 7f+ runs needs monitoring in the betting

races.name: Lycetts Supports The YCC Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Egotistical
runners_data.note: Progressive three-year-old with prominent style perfectly suited to track the expected honest pace from Newmarket raider Varian
runners_data.spotlight: Newmarket raider who looks open to further progress; has made a solid start to her career, with three placed efforts preceding a Redcar novice success (6f, good to firm); one of two handicap debutantes who figure highly in calculations.

runners_data.name: Zarinca
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from in-form Bethell yard who should improve stepping up from maiden company after easy Southwell win
runners_data.comment: Didn't look to see out 7f here when last seen; retains potential for a yard in good form
runners_data.spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who most recently prevailed in Southwell maiden (6f; kept to AW) on seasonal debut; pedigree suggests she should do better still and prove as effective on turf; respected handicap debutante.

runners_data.name: Diamont Katie
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who benefits from strong pace scenarios and showed good form returning to turf with wind surgery helping
runners_data.spotlight: Back in good form since having wind surgery and returned to turf from AW, winning comfortably over C&D (good) then creditable second under a penalty at Yarmouth (7f); back on career-high mark but still looks shortlist material returned to this scenario.

runners_data.name: Saucy Jane
runners_data.note: Prominent style but form declining and trainer struggling for winners, headgear change suggests connections concerned
runners_data.comment: Scored over C&D last May; good chance on these terms, provided she's in top form
runners_data.spotlight: Record is only 1-12; well treated on best efforts but is starting to go the wrong way and ran to nowhere near her rating in 5f seller most recently; chance largely depends on the effects of first-time cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: D Flawless
runners_data.note: Front runner making turf return after AW success but 67 days since last run raises fitness questions for sustained effort
runners_data.spotlight: Has gained both wins on AW, including at Newcastle in latest start when wearing a hood and attempting 6f for the first time; far from solid on her turf form but otherwise may have more to offer at this distance in the retained headgear.

runners_data.name: Ruby Red Gove
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but AW specialist making rare turf appearance with question marks over surface switch from Polytrack form
runners_data.spotlight: AW filly whose record is 1-6, the success at Wolverhampton on handicap debut; form dipped last time when switched to Polytrack from Tapeta; guesswork is involved as regards another change of surface.

runners_data.name: Rogue Temptation
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who hasn't recaptured last year's form but headgear retained suggests connections still believe
runners_data.comment: Gone the wrong way following a good third at Doncaster on her nursery debut;
runners_data.spotlight: Registered a novice success last July and good effort on handicap debut in September but not in the same form since; hopes of a resurgence are mostly pinned on the drop in grade off a reduced mark.

runners_data.name: Storm Esme
runners_data.note: Natural front runner whose spring defeats came in higher grades, making this drop in class significant tactical advantage
runners_data.comment: 2-3 last year; soundly beaten on reappearance last month but may have needed the run
runners_data.spotlight: Record of 2-3 last year suggested she could prove a progressive type this term; that hasn't hitherto materialised but her two spring defeats came in higher grades; may be capable of a bigger effort at this level.

races.paceDynamic: Storm Esme and D Flawless will contest the early lead in this small field of eight fillies, with Storm Esme likely to get first run from her inside draw. The honest gallop these two create should suit the prominent runners like Egotistical, Zarinca and Rogue Temptation who can track the pace without getting caught up in early speed. With only eight runners over six furlongs on good ground, this sets up as a straightforward test of stamina and class rather than a tactical battle. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position handy and kick when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Storm Esme and D Flawless set honest fractions without going too fast early
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the perfect tow into the race and can unleash their finishing kicks when the leaders weaken. Egotistical and Zarinca are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their class and progressive profiles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong between the two leaders
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong allowing the hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Diamont Katie's hold-up style and recent good form make her the prime beneficiary of a strong pace scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leaders Sustain Kick
scenarios.trigger: If Storm Esme or D Flawless can dictate comfortable fractions and keep something in reserve
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters gets an easy lead and has enough left to resist the closers in a tactical finish. Storm Esme's class edge over D Flawless makes her the more likely to succeed if the pace isn't fierce.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Compromised Upset
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders clash early and compromise each other's chances significantly
scenarios.body: The pace becomes either very fast or very slow, creating an unconventional finish that suits an outsider. This chaotic scenario could benefit a horse like Saucy Jane or Rogue Temptation who might sneak through if the favourites falter.

watchPoints.text: Storm Esme and D Flawless must be monitored for early clash that could compromise both leaders' chances significantly
Zarinca's inexperience at this level after just three career starts could see her position poorly if pace becomes tactical
Ruby Red Gove switching from AW specialist role to turf creates uncertainty about her effectiveness on this surface
Diamont Katie needs strong early pace to set up her hold-up style so watch for her positioning if leaders go too slowly
Egotistical represents powerful Varian-Dawson combination making rare Pontefract visit which suggests serious intent for this prize

races.name: KRS Property Solutions Supports The YCC Handicap

runners_data.name: Holly Mist
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making handicap debut for powerful Varian stable, 26 days fresh and stepping up in trip which should suit her pedigree.
runners_data.spotlight: Newmarket raider; six-race maiden who is proving reasonably consistent and whose handicap efforts, all at about 1m, suggest this step up in distance may well prompt progress; first success is conceivable.

runners_data.name: Everyoneknowsadave
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with poor turf record (0-8) but placed off higher marks recently, making each-way appeal despite trainer's current cold spell.
runners_data.comment: Best turf efforts when placed here but his three AW runs this spring were rather muted
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time AW winner who has rather stagnated in that sphere in 2026; record of 0-8 on turf but he was placed off higher marks in last two attempts; each-way possibilities, provided he's back in similar form.

runners_data.name: The Cookstown Cafu
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse coming off AW win at Newcastle, up 5lb but remains well-treated and handles similar distances effectively.
runners_data.comment: Took advantage of a reduced mark to make a winning reappearance at Newcastle last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Campaigned only over 7f-1m; justified favouritism at Newcastle (AW) on seasonal debut, registering a first win since joining current yard; back up 5lb but remains well treated on peak form and he's 2-3 at Pontefract; should remain competitive, provided he stays the new trip.

runners_data.name: Pol Roger
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner who'll get uncontested lead, returning from 53-day break but may struggle to see out this longer trip.
runners_data.comment: Reappearance was probably a step back up the ladder; lacks any win for exactly two years
runners_data.spotlight: On a handy mark and may be back in better form with Thirsk reappearance under his belt; however, he's on two-year losing spell and record suggests he'll be more interesting when returned to Ayr.

runners_data.name: Distinction
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with excellent Pontefract record including wins in 2024/2025, recent close third here suggests return to form.
runners_data.comment: Conditions fine and slipping back down the weights but yet to shine in 2026
runners_data.spotlight: Kept to a track that suits as his form at Pontefract features wins in 2024/2025 and a resurgent effort (close third) in latest start; faces some unexposed types among his younger rivals but holds a solid chance.

runners_data.name: Finlaggan
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who was close second over course and distance, open to further progress for shrewd O'Meara yard after French import.
runners_data.spotlight: Joined shrewd current connections after sole French start; close second over C&D (good) on handicap debut and remains open to further progress back here, having perhaps been unsuited by the track at Ripon since; respected, assuming he takes well to first-time headgear.

runners_data.name: Bay Dream Believer
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner showing return to form at Ripon last time, inconsistent but has good record on similar going.
runners_data.comment: Three-timer last August; down the field at Doncaster and Nottingham this year.
runners_data.spotlight: Showed signs of a return to form at Ripon last time; no certainty to build on that effort, having been inconsistent since a hat-trick last August, but otherwise has become attractively handicapped.

runners_data.name: Thequietman
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning to longer trip which suits pedigree, has been regressive recently but distance change could spark improvement.
runners_data.comment: Placed on AW on stable debut in December but two lesser AW runs followed in January
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden who has been essentially regressive, over 7f/1m in a hood, for current stable; however, pedigree suggests this return to 1m2f is worth exploring; headgear is removed; resurgence is possible.

races.paceDynamic: Pol Roger is the only natural front-runner and will set his own tempo from the start without pressure, creating a controlled gallop through the early stages. With seven hold-up horses behind him, the pace will be steady rather than strong, building gradually as they navigate Pontefract's testing track. The lack of pace pressure means the race will develop into a tactical affair where stamina and finishing kick become crucial over the final 3-4 furlongs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late speed, as they'll get the perfect tactical setup behind an uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Pol Roger gets an easy lead and stays the extended trip strongly
scenarios.body: The confirmed front-runner faces no early pressure and dictates throughout, using his stamina advantage to kick clear in the final furlong when the hold-up horses are still organising their challenges. His style gives him first run while others are still finding racing room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Speed Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the steady pace allows closers to unleash devastating finishing kicks
scenarios.body: The controlled gallop perfectly suits horses with turn of foot, allowing them to make up significant ground in the final 2f when Pol Roger begins to tire. Fresh legs and late speed prove decisive on this demanding track.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Course Specialist Thrives
scenarios.trigger: If Pontefract's unique demands favour proven track performers
scenarios.body: Distinction's proven course form and recent third here becomes the decisive factor as less experienced track runners struggle with the undulations and turns. Local knowledge trumps pure ability on this specialist venue.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the extended trip finds out several runners lacking staying power
scenarios.body: The step up to 1m2f exposes those better over shorter trips, allowing proven stayers like Holly Mist to emerge late when others hit the wall. The demanding finish sorts out the genuine mile-and-a-quarter horses from the milers.

watchPoints.text: Pol Roger could steal this if he gets too easy a lead early and the pace becomes pedestrian through the middle stages.
Watch for Finlaggan getting a smooth run through - he was impressive over course and distance last time and remains unexposed.
The Cookstown Cafu's fitness after 50-day break could be crucial given his recent win was his first for the yard.
Distinction needs to prove his recent Pontefract third wasn't a flash in the pan against stronger opposition here.
Monitor the early pace - if it's too slow, it could set up perfectly for any horse with a genuine turn of foot.

races.name: Morley Glass And Glazing Supports The YCC Handicap

runners_data.name: Ice Cold Alex
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with proven Pontefract form but concerning 29-day absence and poor recent strike rate despite reduced handicap mark.
runners_data.comment: Novice winner on debut as a 2yo; fair form in nurseries; could go well despite high draw
runners_data.spotlight: Sole attempt at Pontefract resulted in his 2yo debut success (5f); 0-7 since but ran respectably at Beverley most recently and is interesting off a reduced mark returned to this venue.

runners_data.name: Dolos Dream
runners_data.note: Prominent style but massive 158-day layoff from AW to turf creates significant fitness doubts despite solid 2yo novice credentials.
runners_data.comment: Second on debut (6f) before a 5f novice win 17 days ago; respected despite penalty
runners_data.spotlight: Brings a solid AW novice record that comprises a 5f success flanked by two placed efforts, all in late 2025; possibilities, provided she's able to show progress on turf.

runners_data.name: Queen Sana
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with consistent form who will control this race but may struggle to repel late challenges over sharp 5f trip.
runners_data.spotlight: Largely consistent filly who has finished second in Windsor handicap (5f; beaten only a head) and Bath maiden (5.7f; behind a subsequent scorer) since switched to turf from AW; solid.

runners_data.name: Believeinmenow
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally suited to 5f after form dipped returning to 6f, with solid recent placings suggesting breakthrough win possible.
runners_data.spotlight: Nine-race maiden whose second-place finishes over 5f in April/May suggest there may be a contest of this nature in him; form dipped when returned to 6f last time.

runners_data.name: Goldenstateofmind
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 46-day break who needs strong pace to be effective but showed promise in 2yo debut over this trip.
runners_data.spotlight: Showed promise with second-place finish at Thirsk (5f) on 2yo debut; has regressed in two starts (6f) since but may stage a turnaround now handicapping.

runners_data.name: Liverpool Star
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with proven 5f form who needs the race to develop into sprint finish, first-time cheekpieces add unknown element.
runners_data.spotlight: Ran creditably last time when bidding for a 6f double (maiden previously); proving consistent and has form at 5f; in the mix, assuming he takes to first-time cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Quantum Power
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning to ideal 5f trip after doing too much work over 6f at Newmarket, strong 2yo winner at this distance.
runners_data.comment: Won 5f Beverley maiden as 2yo; never involved on Bath return (50-1); visor returns
runners_data.spotlight: Ran well at Newmarket last time considering he did a bit too much up front over 6f; gained his 2yo win over 5f and the return to this trip looks ideal; respected off unaltered mark.

races.paceDynamic: Queen Sana will take this race forward as the sole confirmed front-runner, setting a sustainable pace without early pressure from the prominent horses Ice Cold Alex, Believeinmenow, Dolos Dream and Quantum Power who should track behind. The hold-up pair Goldenstateofmind and Liverpool Star will be positioned at the rear, relying on the pace to set up their finishing kicks. With only one genuine leader and several prominent runners not naturally aggressive, this creates a controlled gallop that will build gradually. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can track Queen Sana and strike in the final furlong when she potentially weakens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Queen Sana sets her usual honest pace without being harassed by the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The sustainable gallop allows the prominent horses to conserve energy before unleashing their finishing kicks in the final furlong. Quantum Power and Believeinmenow are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical setup with their proven 5f speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Queen Sana gets an uncontested lead and the prominent runners fail to close strongly enough
scenarios.body: The honest pace plays into Queen Sana's hands as she maintains her rhythm throughout and has enough left to repel late challenges. Her recent near-miss at Windsor over 5f suggests she can capitalise on tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Finish Fast
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stronger than expected and the prominent runners get involved in early pace battles
scenarios.body: A faster gallop sets up perfectly for Goldenstateofmind and Liverpool Star to unleash powerful finishing kicks from the rear. The hold-up pair benefit from increased pace as the prominent runners soften each other up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Queen Sana sets a very slow pace and no prominent runner takes initiative to inject tempo
scenarios.body: The lacklustre gallop becomes a sprint finish where raw speed matters most, potentially suiting any horse with a turn of foot. Ice Cold Alex could benefit from his Pontefract course experience in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Queen Sana breaks fast and builds significant early lead as prominent runners fail to track her closely enough
Dolos Dream shows early sharpness despite 158-day layoff indicating fitness levels better than expected
Quantum Power and Believeinmenow engage in early pace battle rather than settling behind Queen Sana
Liverpool Star and Goldenstateofmind get squeezed for racing room in small field as prominent runners fan across track
Ice Cold Alex shows ring rustiness early having not run for 29 days since last disappointing effort
